{{Quote|Good guys wear white.|A common clone trooper saying|<ref name="GB:CC">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''</ref>}}
'''Phase I clone trooper armor''' was the [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|armor]] worn by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the early stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

To [[Human/Legends|Humans]], the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper's]] armor appeared white overall, but to [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]], clone trooper armor had many [[Color/Legends|colors]] due to them seeing in the ultraviolet spectrum of light. Phase I armor was later replaced by [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]] as the Clone Wars progressed.

==Description==
{{Quote|Your armor, it's shiny and new. Just like you.|[[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone trooper captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], to a group of clone shinies|<ref name="Rookies">{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}}</ref>}}
[[File:Clone_Troopers_Phase_I.jpg|thumb|left|180px|[[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] in standard Phase I armor]]
With some design assistance from [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], the basic armor design became composed of twenty form-fitting plates of lightweight plastoid-alloy composite, sealed to a black bodysuit and weighed just under forty kilograms. Because the armor would be used by an army of physically identical clones, only one size was needed. It loosely resembled [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|shock trooper armor]], as a result of Jango's participation in its design. The austere sensibilities of Kaminoan society resulted in the blindingly pristine white state of each set of armor, although command units originally had stripes of different colors, depending on their rank (yellow meaning [[Clone Commander/Legends|commander]], red meaning [[Clone Captain/Legends|captain]], blue meaning [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], and green meaning [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]]). However, as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] progressed, the colorized markings began to identify the troopers with specific units. The helmets usually had fins on the top which were inspired by some Mandalorian helmet designs.<ref>[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett|''The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett'']]</ref>

As the Clone Wars progressed, some troopers began to show individuality, customizing their armor to adapt to their needs with items such as visors, rangefinders, pauldrons, [[Kama/Legends|''kamas'']], enhanced communications gear, and [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]]. A light source could be attached to the helmets to illuminate dark areas.<ref name="SITC">{{SW|url=video/the-clone-wars-the-clones-are-coming|text=The Clone Wars: The Clones are Coming}}</ref> Some troopers even painted unique designs on their armor and helmets according to personal tastes.

[[File:Clones_Orto_Plutonia.png|thumb|180px|Phase I [[Clone cold assault trooper/Legends|cold assault]] armor variant]]
The armor was heavy, uncomfortable, and not very well liked by clone troopers, hence it being often referred to by non-clone GAR personnel as a "body bucket". Its inconvenience was due to the Kaminoans' lack of knowledge of [[Human/Legends|Human]] anatomy. It did, however, have coolant systems to prevent overheating, and also included enhanced breathing filters inside the T-visor. The armor could take some modular attachments, like a [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] pack for a medic or small [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]] for [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commandos]]. The armor suit also resisted vacuum environments, allowing the trooper to continue to fight outside of spacecraft for a short time (though recovery was needed).

[[File:Rex_helmet_cody_helmet_and_another_helmet.png|left|thumb|220x220px|The [[Helmet/Legends|helmets]] used by clone troopers in phase I armor.]]
Some armor sets, depending on what planet the trooper was stationed, were customized to fit the planet's conditions. For example, those on water planets such as [[Glee Anselm/Legends|Glee Anselm]] had water resistant armor, and advanced breathing equipment for underwater operations, along with fins attached to the boots. The armor of some troopers had symbols to designate the squad that they were in.

==History==
Making its battlefield debut at the start of the Clone Wars, Phase I clone trooper armor was the standard issue equipment donned by the clone troopers who formed the Grand Army of the Republic.<ref name="AOTC" /> The clones took pride in their gear, resulting in the common saying "Good guys wear white."<ref name="GB:CC" /> However, troopers also began to customize their attire as the conflict carried on, such as to represent their unit affiliation. While not all troopers in such a unit would adopt such a personalized appearance for their Phase I gear,<ref name="TCWfilm">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref> perfectly shiny and clean white armor was a sign that a clone trooper was new to the battlefield, earning them the name "[[Shiny/Legends|shinies]] from their more experienced clone brethren.<ref name="Rookies" />

[[File:ScimitarOfKelso.jpg|thumb|right|300px|A squad of stormtroopers during the early Imperial Period wearing Phase I armor alongside [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].]]
During the later part of the Clone Wars, the Phase I sets were mainly replaced by [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II armor]]. However, some clones chose to keep either some, or all of the elements of their Phase I armor, at least until [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], such as [[01/425]], and the ARC troopers who killed [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Sev (Jedi)|Sev]].<ref>{{CWACite|5|The Order of Outcasts}}</ref> Even after the Republic was [[Declaration of a New Order|reorganized]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], some of the newly-rebranded [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Imperial stormtroopers]] continued to use Phase I and Phase II armor before it was replaced by a [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|new design]].<ref name="Republic 78" />

A group of Kaminoan [[Clone Master/Legends|Clone Masters]] would later [[Kaminoan resistance|rebel]] against the new regime, creating a batch of [[Anti-trooper|anti-Imperial clone troopers]] clad in Phase I armor. However, this new clone army would be [[Kamino uprising|defeated]] by their Imperial counterparts.<ref name="Battlefront II" />
